h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in Mississippi? Here Are Your 2026 Health Insurance Options
h1.es: Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Mississippi? Estas Son Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your last day of employer coverage to enroll in a new plan. Mississippi did not expand Medicaid under the ACA, so most laid-off adults must use the ACA Marketplace at healthcare.gov or elect COBRA within the same 60-day window.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador para inscribirse. Mississippi no expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA, por lo que la mayoria de adultos despedidos deben usar el Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov o elegir COBRA dentro de la misma ventana de 60 dias.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your Mississippi coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura en Mississippi

body.en: Your 60-day loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period begins the day after your employer health plan ends in Mississippi. For example, if your last day of coverage is July 31, 2026, your Marketplace SEP window runs August 1 through September 29, 2026. Miss that window and you cannot enroll in a subsidized ACA Marketplace plan until the 2027 Open Enrollment Period opens November 1, 2026. Mississippi Medicaid covers very few laid-off adults because the state did not expand under the ACA, making the 60-day Marketplace SEP window especially critical for Mississippi residents.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias por perdida de cobertura comienza el dia despues de que termina su plan de salud del empleador en Mississippi. Por ejemplo, si su ultimo dia de cobertura es el 31 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP del Mercado corre del 1 de agosto al 29 de septiembre de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA subsidiado hasta que abra el Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta 2027 el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

label.es: Plan del empleador del conyuge (si disponible)

label.en: Mississippi Medicaid (limited to specific categories, not income-expansion)
label.es: Medicaid de Mississippi (limitado a categorias especificas, sin expansion de ingresos)

quickAnswer.en: Losing job-based health insurance in Mississippi triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Unlike 40 other states, Mississippi did not expand Medicaid under the ACA, so most laid-off adults without children or a qualifying disability will not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid regardless of income. Your main options are: (1) ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov with income-based premium tax credits, typically $10 to $300 per month for moderate-income applicants in 2026; (2) COBRA continuation at 102% of your full employer premium, often $500 to $2,000 per month; or (3) your spouse's employer plan if available within 30 days. Mississippi parents with very low income (under approximately 26% FPL) may qualify for Mississippi Medicaid. The 2026 ACA subsidy cliff returned at 400% FPL after enhanced premium tax credits expired January 1, 2026.
quickAnswer.es: Perder el seguro medico del trabajo en Mississippi activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias. A diferencia de otros 40 estados, Mississippi no expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA, por lo que la mayoria de adultos despedidos sin hijos o discapacidad calificadora no calificara para Medicaid de Mississippi independientemente de sus ingresos. Sus opciones principales son: (1) plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov con creditos fiscales de prima basados en ingresos, tipicamente $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de ingresos moderados en 2026; (2) continuacion COBRA al 102% de la prima completa del empleador, a menudo $500 a $2,000 al mes; o (3) el plan del empleador de su conyuge si esta disponible dentro de 30 dias. Los padres de Mississippi con ingresos muy bajos (menos de aproximadamente el 26% FPL) pueden calificar para Medicaid de Mississippi.

introParagraphs.en: Losing a job in Mississippi comes with a health coverage crisis that is more complicated than in most other states. Mississippi is one of ten states that chose not to expand Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act, meaning the standard safety net available in 40 states and DC does not apply here. In expansion states, any adult whose projected income falls under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level qualifies for free Medicaid. Mississippi does not offer that. Instead, Mississippi Medicaid covers only specific categories of adults: parents and caretaker relatives earning under approximately 26% FPL (about $7,800 per year for a household of three in 2026), pregnant women, children through age 18 (via Mississippi CHIP under the Mississippi Division of Medicaid), and adults with qualifying disabilities. A childless adult who loses a job in Mississippi and has income between zero and 100% FPL falls into a coverage gap with no Medicaid and no ACA subsidy. The Marketplace Special Enrollment Period under HIPAA Section 9831 is the primary and often the only path to subsidized coverage for most Mississippi residents who lose job-based insurance in 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Mississippi conlleva una crisis de cobertura medica mas complicada que en la mayoria de otros estados. Mississippi es uno de diez estados que eligio no expandir Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible, lo que significa que la red de seguridad estandar disponible en 40 estados y DC no aplica aqui. En los estados de expansion, cualquier adulto cuyo ingreso proyectado cae por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza califica para Medicaid gratuito. Mississippi no ofrece eso. En cambio, Medicaid de Mississippi cubre solo categorias especificas de adultos: padres y parientes cuidadores con ingresos por debajo de aproximadamente el 26% FPL, mujeres embarazadas, ninos hasta los 18 anos (a traves del CHIP de Mississippi), y adultos con discapacidades calificadoras. Un adulto sin hijos que pierde un trabajo en Mississippi con ingresos entre cero y 100% FPL cae en una brecha de cobertura sin Medicaid y sin subsidio ACA. El Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado bajo la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA es el camino principal para la mayoria de residentes de Mississippi que pierden un seguro basado en el trabajo en 2026.

introParagraphs.en: Mississippi residents who lose job-based coverage in 2026 and have projected income between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 for a single person, $33,000 to $132,000 for a family of four per the 2026 HHS ASPE Poverty Guidelines) qualify for premium tax credits on ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned for plan year 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026, so households above 400% FPL receive no subsidy. The ACA Marketplace qualifying life event (QLE) for loss of coverage applies to Mississippi residents the same as in every other state: 60 days from the coverage loss date. Mississippi uses healthcare.gov for Marketplace enrollment, not a separate state exchange. Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions (CSR) are available for households between 100% and 250% FPL, reducing out-of-pocket costs significantly and often making Silver the best value for lower-income Mississippi residents in the 60-day SEP window.
introParagraphs.es: Los residentes de Mississippi que pierden cobertura basada en el trabajo en 2026 y tienen ingresos proyectados entre el 100% y 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 para una persona, $33,000 a $132,000 para una familia de cuatro segun las Guias de Pobreza HHS ASPE 2026) califican para creditos fiscales de prima en planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. El precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL regreso para el ano del plan 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que los hogares sobre el 400% FPL no reciben subsidio. El evento calificador de vida del Mercado ACA para perdida de cobertura aplica a los residentes de Mississippi igual que en cualquier otro estado: 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura. Mississippi usa healthcare.gov para la inscripcion en el Mercado, no un intercambio estatal separado.

name.en: Confirm your last day of employer coverage in Mississippi
name.es: Confirme su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador en Mississippi

text.en: Contact your Mississippi employer's HR department or review your termination paperwork to get the exact date your group health plan coverage ends. Most employer plans in Mississippi end on the last day of the month you were terminated. That date starts your 60-day Marketplace SEP clock. Request a HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage in writing from your employer. You will need this document as proof of the qualifying life event when you submit your SEP application at healthcare.gov.
text.es: Contacte al departamento de recursos humanos de su empleador en Mississippi o revise sus documentos de terminacion para obtener la fecha exacta en que termina su cobertura de plan de salud grupal. La mayoria de planes del empleador en Mississippi terminan el ultimo dia del mes en que fue despedido. Esa fecha inicia su reloj SEP de 60 dias del Mercado. Solicite un certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA por escrito a su empleador. Necesitara este documento como prueba del evento calificador de vida.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 household income accurately
name.es: Calcule con precision su ingreso proyectado del hogar para 2026

text.en: Use only what you expect to earn for the remainder of 2026, not your prior annual salary. Include Mississippi unemployment compensation in your projection (unemployment benefits count as Modified Adjusted Gross Income under IRS rules). Mississippi's maximum weekly unemployment benefit in 2026 is $235 per week for up to 26 weeks. Your projected income determines whether you qualify for premium tax credits, cost-sharing reductions on Silver plans, or fall into the non-expansion coverage gap. For 2026, the 100% FPL threshold is $15,960 for a single person and $33,000 for a family of four.
text.es: Use solo lo que espera ganar durante el resto de 2026, no su salario anual anterior. Incluya la compensacion por desempleo de Mississippi en su proyeccion (los beneficios de desempleo cuentan como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado bajo las reglas del IRS). La compensacion maxima semanal de desempleo de Mississippi en 2026 es $235 por semana por hasta 26 semanas. Su ingreso proyectado determina si califica para creditos fiscales de prima, reducciones de costos compartidos en planes Silver, o cae en la brecha de cobertura de no expansion. Para 2026, el umbral del 100% FPL es $15,960 para una persona y $33,000 para una familia de cuatro.

name.en: Check whether you qualify for Mississippi Medicaid (specific categories only)
name.es: Verifique si califica para Medicaid de Mississippi (solo categorias especificas)

text.en: Mississippi Medicaid does not cover most laid-off adults under the ACA expansion. Apply at mississippi.gov/mdhs or through the Mississippi Division of Medicaid at medicaid.ms.gov. Mississippi Medicaid covers: parents and caretaker relatives with income under approximately 26% FPL (about $7,800 per year for a family of three), pregnant women, children through age 18 via CHIP, and people with qualifying disabilities receiving SSI. If you have children under 19 in your household, apply for them through Mississippi CHIP regardless of your own eligibility, as CHIP income limits reach 200% FPL for children.
text.es: Medicaid de Mississippi no cubre a la mayoria de adultos despedidos bajo la expansion ACA. Solicite en mississippi.gov/mdhs o a traves de la Division de Medicaid de Mississippi en medicaid.ms.gov. Medicaid de Mississippi cubre: padres y parientes cuidadores con ingresos por debajo de aproximadamente el 26% FPL (aproximadamente $7,800 al ano para una familia de tres), mujeres embarazadas, ninos hasta los 18 anos a traves de CHIP, y personas con discapacidades calificadoras que reciben SSI. Si tiene hijos menores de 19 anos en su hogar, solicite para ellos a traves del CHIP de Mississippi independientemente de su propia elegibilidad.

name.en: Apply for ACA Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov if income is above 100% FPL
name.es: Solicite el SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov si el ingreso supera el 100% FPL

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov and select 'Report a life event' then 'Lost health insurance through a job.' Upload your termination letter or HIPAA certificate as documentation of the qualifying life event. Mississippi uses healthcare.gov directly, not a separate state exchange. Compare Silver and Bronze plan options for your Mississippi ZIP code. Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions are the best value for projected incomes between 100% and 250% FPL in 2026. Premium tax credits bring most Silver plans to $10 to $300 per month for moderate-income Mississippi applicants. Enter your projected 2026 income accurately using your post-job-loss projection, not your former salary.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov y seleccione 'Reportar un evento de vida' y luego 'Perdi el seguro medico a traves de un trabajo.' Cargue su carta de terminacion o certificado HIPAA como documentacion del evento calificador de vida. Mississippi usa healthcare.gov directamente, no un intercambio estatal separado. Compare opciones de planes Silver y Bronze para su codigo postal de Mississippi. Los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos son el mejor valor para ingresos proyectados entre el 100% y 250% FPL en 2026. Los creditos fiscales de prima llevan la mayoria de planes Silver a $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de ingresos moderados en Mississippi.

name.en: Check whether your spouse's employer plan is available within 30 days
name.es: Verifique si el plan del empleador de su conyuge esta disponible dentro de 30 dias

text.en: Your Mississippi job loss is a qualifying life event for your spouse's employer plan as well, giving you 30 days to enroll under their coverage. Call your spouse's HR department immediately because this 30-day window is separate from and shorter than the 60-day Marketplace SEP window. Your spouse's employer plan may be the cheapest option if it is subsidized by the employer and the network includes your Mississippi doctors and specialists. Compare monthly premium and out-of-pocket costs against Marketplace options before deciding.
text.es: La perdida de su trabajo en Mississippi es tambien un evento calificador de vida para el plan del empleador de su conyuge, dandole 30 dias para inscribirse bajo su cobertura. Llame inmediatamente al departamento de recursos humanos de su conyuge porque esta ventana de 30 dias es separada y mas corta que la ventana SEP del Mercado de 60 dias. El plan del empleador de su conyuge puede ser la opcion mas barata si esta subsidiado por el empleador y la red incluye sus medicos y especialistas en Mississippi. Compare el costo mensual de la prima y los gastos de bolsillo contra las opciones del Mercado antes de decidir.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA continuation only as a last resort
name.es: Evalue la continuacion COBRA solo como ultimo recurso

text.en: COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, meaning you pay both the employer and employee share plus a 2% administrative fee. For a single person in Mississippi, that typically runs $500 to $900 per month in 2026; for a family, $1,200 to $2,800 per month. You have 60 days to elect COBRA and can do so retroactively, meaning you do not have to decide immediately. COBRA makes sense only if you have ongoing treatment with a Mississippi specialist not available in any Marketplace network, or if you have substantially met your 2026 deductible and need to maintain the same plan through year-end. Compare your COBRA premium against healthcare.gov options before electing.
text.es: COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, lo que significa que paga tanto la parte del empleador como la del empleado mas una tarifa administrativa del 2%. Para una persona en Mississippi, eso tipicamente alcanza $500 a $900 al mes en 2026; para una familia, $1,200 a $2,800 al mes. Tiene 60 dias para elegir COBRA y puede hacerlo retroactivamente, lo que significa que no tiene que decidir de inmediato. COBRA tiene sentido solo si tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista en Mississippi que no esta disponible en ninguna red del Mercado, o si ha cumplido sustancialmente su deducible de 2026. Compare su prima COBRA con las opciones de healthcare.gov antes de elegir.

name.en: Enroll in CHIP for your children even if you do not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid
name.es: Inscribirse en CHIP para sus hijos aunque no califique para Medicaid de Mississippi

text.en: Mississippi CHIP covers children through age 18 with household incomes up to 200% FPL ($33,000 for a family of one child and one adult in 2026). CHIP enrollment in Mississippi is year-round with no deadline. Even if you do not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid as an adult, your children very likely qualify for CHIP at low or zero cost. Apply at medicaid.ms.gov or through healthcare.gov. Mississippi CHIP is administered by the Mississippi Division of Medicaid and provides comprehensive pediatric coverage including dental and vision.
text.es: CHIP de Mississippi cubre ninos hasta los 18 anos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 200% FPL. La inscripcion de CHIP en Mississippi es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Aunque usted no califique para Medicaid de Mississippi como adulto, sus hijos muy probablemente califiquen para CHIP a bajo costo o sin costo. Solicite en medicaid.ms.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov. CHIP de Mississippi es administrado por la Division de Medicaid de Mississippi y proporciona cobertura pediatrica completa, incluyendo dental y vision.

intro.en: The costliest mistakes Mississippi residents make after losing job-based coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que los residentes de Mississippi cometen despues de perder la cobertura del trabajo en 2026:

items.en: Assuming Mississippi Medicaid will cover them as adults. Mississippi is a non-expansion state. Most laid-off adults without qualifying children or disabilities do not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid regardless of how low their income drops. The Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov is the only subsidized option for most.
items.es: Asumir que Medicaid de Mississippi los cubrira como adultos. Mississippi es un estado sin expansion. La mayoria de adultos despedidos sin hijos calificadores o discapacidades no califican para Medicaid de Mississippi independientemente de cuan bajo caiga su ingreso. El SEP del Mercado en healthcare.gov es la unica opcion subsidiada para la mayoria.

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without comparing Marketplace options at healthcare.gov. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, often $500 to $900 per month for a single person. ACA Marketplace Silver plans with income-based subsidies typically cost $10 to $300 per month for Mississippi applicants with moderate projected income.
items.es: Optar automaticamente por COBRA sin comparar opciones del Mercado en healthcare.gov. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, a menudo $500 a $900 al mes para una persona. Los planes Silver del Mercado ACA con subsidios basados en ingresos tipicamente cuestan $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de Mississippi con ingresos proyectados moderados.

items.en: Reporting the prior annual Mississippi salary instead of projected 2026 income after job loss. The ACA Marketplace calculates subsidies on Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for the remainder of 2026. A lower projected income means larger premium tax credits. Most applicants who just lost a job will project significantly lower income than what they earned while employed.
items.es: Reportar el salario anual anterior en Mississippi en lugar del ingreso proyectado de 2026 despues de perder el trabajo. El Mercado ACA calcula los subsidios sobre el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para el resto de 2026. Un ingreso proyectado mas bajo significa creditos fiscales de prima mas grandes. La mayoria de solicitantes que acaban de perder un trabajo proyectaran ingresos significativamente menores.

items.en: Missing the 60-day Marketplace SEP window. Without the qualifying life event SEP documentation submitted to healthcare.gov before Day 60, Mississippi residents cannot access subsidized ACA coverage until the 2027 OEP starting November 1, 2026. Medicaid for most Mississippi adults is not an alternative due to the non-expansion status.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP del Mercado de 60 dias. Sin la documentacion del evento calificador de vida enviada a healthcare.gov antes del dia 60, los residentes de Mississippi no pueden acceder a la cobertura ACA subsidiada hasta la OEP 2027 que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026. Medicaid para la mayoria de adultos de Mississippi no es una alternativa debido al estado de no expansion.

items.en: Forgetting that Mississippi unemployment compensation counts as income for ACA subsidy calculations. Include weekly benefit amounts multiplied by expected weeks received when projecting 2026 income at healthcare.gov. Mississippi's maximum benefit is $235 per week, so even maximum unemployment benefits keep most single applicants well below the 400% FPL subsidy cliff.
items.es: Olvidar que la compensacion por desempleo de Mississippi cuenta como ingreso para los calculos de subsidio ACA. Incluya los montos de beneficios semanales multiplicados por las semanas esperadas de recibir al proyectar el ingreso de 2026 en healthcare.gov. El beneficio maximo de Mississippi es $235 por semana, por lo que incluso los maximos beneficios de desempleo mantienen a la mayoria de solicitantes individuales muy por debajo del precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL.

items.en: Not enrolling Mississippi children in CHIP separately. Even if an adult parent does not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid, children up to 200% FPL qualify for Mississippi CHIP with comprehensive coverage. CHIP enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Apply at medicaid.ms.gov or through healthcare.gov.
items.es: No inscribir a los ninos de Mississippi en CHIP por separado. Aunque un padre adulto no califique para Medicaid de Mississippi, los ninos hasta el 200% FPL califican para CHIP de Mississippi con cobertura completa. La inscripcion en CHIP es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Solicite en medicaid.ms.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov.

heading.en: COBRA vs ACA Marketplace vs Spouse's Plan in Mississippi: Which Should You Choose in 2026?
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado ACA vs Plan del Conyuge en Mississippi: Cual Debe Elegir en 2026?

body.en: After losing job-based coverage in Mississippi in 2026, three major pathways open for most adults. COBRA preserves your old plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $900 per month for an individual and $1,200 to $2,800 per month for family coverage in Mississippi, making it the most expensive option in almost every scenario. ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov drop most Mississippi enrollees to $10 to $300 per month after income-based premium tax credits in 2026, per KFF Marketplace Premium Analysis, with the trade-off that you may need to change providers if your former employer's network differs from available Marketplace plan networks in Mississippi. A spouse's employer plan costs the employee share of the group premium, often $100 to $600 per month, and is available if your spouse's employer offers a 30-day qualifying-event window under HIPAA Section 9831. Mississippi Medicaid is not a realistic option for most laid-off Mississippi adults due to the state's non-expansion status. The decision framework for Mississippi is: check Mississippi CHIP first for any children under 19 (year-round, 200% FPL threshold); check spouse's employer plan within 30 days if available and network includes your Mississippi providers; apply for ACA Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov with premium tax credits (the primary path for most Mississippi adults losing job coverage in 2026); use COBRA only as a last resort when you have ongoing treatment with a Mississippi specialist not in any Marketplace network.
body.es: Despues de perder cobertura basada en el trabajo en Mississippi en 2026, tres caminos principales se abren para la mayoria de adultos. COBRA preserva su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $900 al mes para un individuo y $1,200 a $2,800 al mes para cobertura familiar en Mississippi, convirtiendolo en la opcion mas cara en casi todos los escenarios. Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov reducen a la mayoria de los inscritos de Mississippi a $10 a $300 al mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima basados en ingresos en 2026, con la compensacion de que puede necesitar cambiar de proveedores si la red de su antiguo empleador difiere de las redes de planes disponibles en Mississippi. El plan del empleador de un conyuge cuesta la parte del empleado de la prima grupal, a menudo $100 a $600 al mes. Medicaid de Mississippi no es una opcion realista para la mayoria de adultos de Mississippi despedidos debido al estado de no expansion del estado. El marco de decision para Mississippi es: verificar CHIP de Mississippi primero para cualquier nino menor de 19 anos; verificar el plan del conyuge dentro de 30 dias si esta disponible; solicitar el SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov con creditos fiscales; usar COBRA solo como ultimo recurso.

Los adultos con ingresos entre el 0% y 100% FPL que no tienen hijos o discapacidades calificadoras enfrentan una brecha de cobertura en Mississippi: no califican para Medicaid de Mississippi y no pueden recibir subsidios ACA por debajo del 100% FPL. El precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL regreso para el ano del plan 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026.

Proof of Mississippi residence (utility bill, lease agreement, or bank statement with Mississippi address for plan availability by ZIP code)

Certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA o aviso de eleccion COBRA de su antiguo empleador en Mississippi

Reporting prior annual Mississippi salary instead of projected 2026 post-job-loss income, causing incorrect subsidy calculation or triggering a tax-time repayment of excess advance premium tax credits via Form 1095-A

Reportar el salario anual anterior en Mississippi en lugar del ingreso proyectado de 2026 despues de perder el trabajo, causando un calculo incorrecto del subsidio o generando un reembolso al momento de impuestos de creditos fiscales de prima anticipados en exceso mediante el Formulario 1095-A

stateRules.rule: Mississippi did not expand Medicaid under the ACA. Adult Medicaid eligibility is limited to parents and caretaker relatives earning under approximately 26% FPL, pregnant women, children through age 18 via CHIP, and adults with qualifying disabilities. There is no income expansion for childless adults. Mississippi uses healthcare.gov for Marketplace enrollment. Apply for Medicaid or CHIP at medicaid.ms.gov.

Mississippi CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program) covers children through age 18 with household income up to 200% FPL. CHIP is administered by the Mississippi Division of Medicaid. Enrollment is year-round. Apply at medicaid.ms.gov or healthcare.gov.

Mississippi maximum weekly unemployment benefit in 2026 is $235 per week for up to 26 weeks, administered by the Mississippi Department of Employment Security (MDES). Unemployment compensation counts as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for ACA subsidy eligibility calculations at healthcare.gov.

heading.en: Mississippi's Coverage Gap: Why Non-Expansion Status Matters for Laid-Off Workers
heading.es: La Brecha de Cobertura de Mississippi: Por Que el Estado de No Expansion Importa para los Trabajadores Despedidos

paragraphs.en: Mississippi is one of ten states that chose not to expand Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act. This decision creates a coverage gap that directly affects laid-off Mississippi workers. In the 40 expansion states plus DC, any adult with projected income under 138% FPL qualifies for free Medicaid coverage regardless of employment status. In Mississippi, that same adult qualifies for nothing unless they are a parent under approximately 26% FPL, pregnant, under 19 years old, or receiving SSI disability benefits. A single adult in Mississippi who loses a $35,000-per-year job and has no other income qualifies for no Mississippi Medicaid and, because their projected 2026 income from remaining employment and unemployment compensation may fall below 100% FPL, may also receive no ACA Marketplace subsidy. This is the coverage gap that policy advocates call the 'Medicaid expansion gap.' For Mississippi residents in this gap, the only realistic options are COBRA (expensive), a short-term non-ACA-compliant plan (limited coverage), or going uninsured until another qualifying event occurs.
paragraphs.es: Mississippi es uno de diez estados que eligio no expandir Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible. Esta decision crea una brecha de cobertura que afecta directamente a los trabajadores de Mississippi despedidos. En los 40 estados de expansion mas DC, cualquier adulto con ingresos proyectados bajo el 138% FPL califica para cobertura Medicaid gratuita independientemente del estado de empleo. En Mississippi, ese mismo adulto no califica para nada a menos que sea padre bajo aproximadamente el 26% FPL, este embarazada, tenga menos de 19 anos, o reciba beneficios de discapacidad SSI. Un adulto soltero en Mississippi que pierde un trabajo de $35,000 al ano y no tiene otros ingresos no califica para Medicaid de Mississippi y, porque sus ingresos proyectados de 2026 del empleo restante y la compensacion por desempleo pueden caer por debajo del 100% FPL, tambien puede no recibir ningun subsidio del Mercado ACA.

paragraphs.en: Mississippi residents who do qualify for ACA Marketplace subsidies (income between 100% and 400% FPL) after a job loss should prioritize Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions at healthcare.gov. For 2026, the ACA Marketplace out-of-pocket maximum is $10,600 for an individual and $21,200 for a family. CSR Silver plans reduce those maximums significantly for households under 250% FPL. At 100% to 150% FPL, CSR plans can reduce individual out-of-pocket maximums to as low as $3,000. Mississippi has no state-based exchange supplement; all CSR plan access runs through healthcare.gov. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned for plan year 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits expired January 1, 2026, meaning Mississippi households with projected annual income above $63,840 for a single person receive no premium tax credit under current law.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Mississippi que si califican para subsidios del Mercado ACA (ingresos entre el 100% y 400% FPL) despues de una perdida de trabajo deben priorizar los planes Silver con reducciones de costos compartidos en healthcare.gov. Para 2026, el maximo de gasto de bolsillo del Mercado ACA es $10,600 para un individuo y $21,200 para una familia. Los planes Silver CSR reducen esos maximos significativamente para hogares bajo el 250% FPL. A ingresos del 100% al 150% FPL, los planes CSR pueden reducir los maximos de gastos de bolsillo individuales a tan bajos como $3,000. Mississippi no tiene complemento de intercambio estatal; todo el acceso a planes CSR corre a traves de healthcare.gov.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov: Step-by-Step for Mississippi Residents
heading.es: SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov: Paso a Paso para Residentes de Mississippi

paragraphs.en: Mississippi uses healthcare.gov for all ACA Marketplace enrollment. There is no separate Mississippi state exchange. To apply for the loss-of-coverage SEP, go to healthcare.gov and create or log in to your account. Select 'Report a life event' and choose 'Lost health insurance through a job or employer.' The system will prompt you to upload documentation of the qualifying life event. Your employer termination letter or HIPAA certificate of creditable coverage satisfies this requirement. You will then enter your projected 2026 income, which determines your premium tax credit amount. Use your projected post-job-loss income, including expected unemployment compensation from MDES, not your prior annual salary. Mississippi ZIP codes determine which ACA plans are available in your area. Compare plans carefully by network (list of Mississippi doctors and hospitals in-network), premium, deductible, and out-of-pocket maximum. Coverage under a Marketplace SEP plan typically begins on the first of the month after you select the plan, so apply as early in the 60-day window as possible.
paragraphs.es: Mississippi usa healthcare.gov para toda la inscripcion en el Mercado ACA. No hay un intercambio estatal separado de Mississippi. Para solicitar el SEP de perdida de cobertura, vaya a healthcare.gov y cree o inicie sesion en su cuenta. Seleccione 'Reportar un evento de vida' y elija 'Perdi el seguro medico a traves de un trabajo o empleador.' El sistema le pedira que cargue documentacion del evento calificador de vida. Su carta de terminacion del empleador o certificado de cobertura acreditable de HIPAA satisface este requisito. Luego ingresara sus ingresos proyectados de 2026, que determinan el monto de su credito fiscal de prima. Use sus ingresos proyectados post-perdida de trabajo, incluyendo la compensacion por desempleo esperada de MDES, no su salario anual anterior.

paragraphs.en: Form 1095-A is the key tax document for Mississippi residents who enroll through a Marketplace SEP plan. Healthcare.gov sends the 1095-A in January of the following year. Mississippi Marketplace enrollees use the 1095-A to complete Schedule PTC (Premium Tax Credit) when filing their federal return. If your actual 2026 income turns out higher than your projection, you may owe back some advance premium tax credits; if lower, you receive an additional refund. Mississippi has no state income tax implications specific to Marketplace enrollment (Mississippi does not levy a state income tax on standard wages in 2026 for most filers), simplifying the reconciliation. Keep all documentation of your qualifying life event and income projections for at least three years after filing.
paragraphs.es: El Formulario 1095-A es el documento fiscal clave para los residentes de Mississippi que se inscriben a traves de un plan SEP del Mercado. Healthcare.gov envia el 1095-A en enero del ano siguiente. Los inscritos del Mercado de Mississippi usan el 1095-A para completar el Anexo PTC (Credito Fiscal de Prima) al presentar su declaracion federal. Si sus ingresos reales de 2026 resultan ser mas altos que su proyeccion, puede que deba devolver algunos creditos fiscales de prima anticipados; si son mas bajos, recibe un reembolso adicional. Conserve toda la documentacion de su evento calificador de vida y las proyecciones de ingresos durante al menos tres anos despues de presentar.

heading.en: Mississippi CHIP and Children's Coverage After a Parent Loses a Job
heading.es: CHIP de Mississippi y Cobertura de Ninos Despues de Que un Padre Pierde el Trabajo

paragraphs.en: Mississippi CHIP covers children through age 18 whose households earn up to 200% FPL. For 2026, 200% FPL is $33,000 for a family of two and $43,000 for a family of three (using 2026 HHS ASPE poverty guidelines). CHIP enrollment in Mississippi is year-round with no SEP deadline. Mississippi CHIP is administered by the Mississippi Division of Medicaid and provides comprehensive pediatric coverage, including well-child visits, immunizations, dental, vision, mental health, and prescription drugs. Even if you as the laid-off parent do not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid due to the state's non-expansion status, your children's CHIP eligibility is independent. Apply for Mississippi CHIP at medicaid.ms.gov or through healthcare.gov; both portals screen for CHIP eligibility simultaneously with Marketplace applications.
paragraphs.es: CHIP de Mississippi cubre ninos hasta los 18 anos cuyos hogares ganan hasta el 200% FPL. Para 2026, el 200% FPL es $33,000 para una familia de dos y $43,000 para una familia de tres. La inscripcion en CHIP en Mississippi es todo el ano sin fecha limite SEP. CHIP de Mississippi es administrado por la Division de Medicaid de Mississippi y proporciona cobertura pediatrica completa, incluyendo visitas de bienestar infantil, inmunizaciones, dental, vision, salud mental y medicamentos recetados. Aunque usted como padre despedido no califique para Medicaid de Mississippi debido al estado de no expansion del estado, la elegibilidad de CHIP de sus hijos es independiente.

paragraphs.en: Mississippi CHIP premiums are very low or zero for most qualifying households. For families at or below 150% FPL ($24,930 for a family of two, $31,250 for a family of three in 2026), premiums are typically zero. Between 150% and 200% FPL, premiums are nominal. Mississippi CHIP also covers dental and vision benefits that are not always available in adult ACA Marketplace plans at comparable cost. If you are enrolling in a Marketplace plan during your 60-day SEP, you can simultaneously apply for Mississippi CHIP for your children at healthcare.gov; the system will route each household member to the most appropriate coverage based on income and age.
paragraphs.es: Las primas de CHIP de Mississippi son muy bajas o nulas para la mayoria de hogares calificadores. Para familias en o por debajo del 150% FPL, las primas son tipicamente cero. Entre el 150% y 200% FPL, las primas son nominales. CHIP de Mississippi tambien cubre beneficios dentales y de vision que no siempre estan disponibles en planes del Mercado ACA para adultos a un costo comparable. Si se inscribe en un plan del Mercado durante su SEP de 60 dias, puede solicitar simultaneamente CHIP de Mississippi para sus hijos en healthcare.gov.

en.question: What is the Special Enrollment Period window after losing a job in Mississippi in 2026?
en.answer: Your loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period starts the day after your employer health coverage ends in Mississippi and runs for 60 consecutive days. For example, if coverage ends July 31, 2026, your SEP window runs August 1 through September 29, 2026. Submit your application and select a plan before Day 60 at healthcare.gov. Mississippi uses healthcare.gov for all Marketplace enrollment, not a separate state exchange. Plans typically take effect on the first of the month following enrollment. Mississippi Medicaid is not year-round for most adults due to the state's non-expansion status, making this 60-day window especially important.

en.question: Does Mississippi have Medicaid expansion? Can I get Medicaid after losing my job?
en.answer: Mississippi did not expand Medicaid under the ACA. Mississippi Medicaid for adults is limited to parents and caretaker relatives with income under approximately 26% FPL (about $7,800 per year for a family of three), pregnant women, children through age 18, and adults with qualifying disabilities receiving SSI. Most laid-off Mississippi adults without children or qualifying disabilities will not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid regardless of how low their income drops. The Mississippi Division of Medicaid administers the program at medicaid.ms.gov. For most Mississippi residents who lose a job, the ACA Marketplace SEP at healthcare.gov is the only path to subsidized coverage.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it after losing a job in Mississippi in 2026?
en.answer: COBRA is rarely the best financial choice after a Mississippi job loss. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, meaning you pay both the employer and employee share plus a 2% administrative fee. For a single person in Mississippi, that typically runs $500 to $900 per month in 2026; for a family, $1,200 to $2,800 per month. ACA Marketplace Silver plans with income-based premium tax credits at healthcare.gov typically cost $10 to $300 per month for Mississippi applicants with moderate projected income. COBRA makes sense mainly when you have ongoing treatment with a Mississippi specialist not in any Marketplace network, or when you have already substantially met your 2026 deductible and need to keep the same plan through year-end.

en.question: What is the coverage gap in Mississippi and who falls into it?
en.answer: The Mississippi coverage gap affects adults with projected annual income between 0% and 100% FPL who do not have qualifying children or disabilities. In 2026, 100% FPL is $15,960 for a single person and $33,000 for a family of four. These adults earn too little to qualify for ACA Marketplace subsidies (which start at 100% FPL) but do not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid (which covers few non-disabled adults without children). The gap exists because Mississippi chose not to expand Medicaid. Adults in the Mississippi coverage gap may consider COBRA if recently employed, or short-term plans, but have no subsidized ACA option until income rises above 100% FPL or another qualifying event occurs.

en.question: Does Mississippi unemployment compensation count toward ACA subsidy eligibility?
en.answer: Yes. Mississippi unemployment compensation from the Mississippi Department of Employment Security (MDES) counts as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for ACA subsidy calculations at healthcare.gov. Include your weekly benefit amount multiplied by the number of weeks you expect to receive it in your projected 2026 annual income. Mississippi's maximum weekly benefit is $235 per week for up to 26 weeks. Even at maximum Mississippi unemployment benefits, most single applicants project annual income well below the 400% FPL subsidy cliff of $63,840, qualifying for premium tax credits on Marketplace plans.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP after losing my job in Mississippi?
en.answer: Missing the 60-day Marketplace SEP after a Mississippi job loss means you cannot enroll in a subsidized ACA plan until the 2027 Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027 for coverage starting January 1, 2027. Unlike most other states, Mississippi's non-expansion status means Medicaid is not an open alternative for most adults during the gap. If another qualifying life event occurs (moving within Mississippi to an area with different plan availability, having a baby, getting married), that event restarts a new 60-day SEP. Mississippi children can still enroll in CHIP year-round at medicaid.ms.gov regardless of a parent's SEP status.

en.question: What state-specific rules apply to job loss health insurance in Mississippi in 2026?
en.answer: Mississippi did not expand Medicaid, leaving most laid-off adults without Medicaid as an option. Mississippi uses healthcare.gov for Marketplace enrollment, not a separate state exchange. Mississippi CHIP covers children under 19 up to 200% FPL at medicaid.ms.gov. Mississippi unemployment benefits are capped at $235 per week for 26 weeks per the Mississippi Department of Employment Security. Mississippi has no state continuation coverage law comparable to Cal-COBRA for smaller employers; federal COBRA applies to employers with 20 or more employees, and Mississippi employers with fewer than 20 employees may offer no continuation coverage. The Mississippi Division of Medicaid administers both Medicaid and CHIP; contact them at medicaid.ms.gov or 1-800-421-2408 for eligibility verification.

en.question: What happens to my children's coverage after I lose my job in Mississippi?
en.answer: Mississippi CHIP covers children through age 18 with household income up to 200% FPL, which is $33,000 for a family of two and approximately $43,000 for a family of three in 2026. CHIP enrollment in Mississippi is year-round with no deadline, unlike the 60-day Marketplace SEP that applies to adult coverage. Apply for Mississippi CHIP at medicaid.ms.gov or through healthcare.gov, which screens all household members simultaneously. Even if you do not qualify for Mississippi Medicaid as a laid-off adult due to the state's non-expansion status, your children's CHIP eligibility is determined independently by their age and household income. Mississippi CHIP covers comprehensive benefits including well-child visits, immunizations, dental, vision, and prescription drugs.

es.question: Cual es la ventana del Periodo de Inscripcion Especial despues de perder un trabajo en Mississippi en 2026?
es.answer: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por perdida de cobertura comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura medica del empleador en Mississippi y dura 60 dias consecutivos. Por ejemplo, si la cobertura termina el 31 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre del 1 de agosto al 29 de septiembre de 2026. Envie su solicitud y seleccione un plan antes del dia 60 en healthcare.gov. Mississippi usa healthcare.gov para toda la inscripcion en el Mercado, no un intercambio estatal separado. Medicaid de Mississippi no es una opcion de ano completo para la mayoria de adultos debido al estado de no expansion del estado, haciendo que esta ventana de 60 dias sea especialmente importante.

es.question: Tiene Mississippi la expansion de Medicaid? Puedo obtener Medicaid despues de perder mi trabajo?
es.answer: Mississippi no expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA. Medicaid de Mississippi para adultos se limita a padres y parientes cuidadores con ingresos bajo aproximadamente el 26% FPL, mujeres embarazadas, ninos hasta los 18 anos y adultos con discapacidades calificadoras que reciben SSI. La mayoria de adultos de Mississippi despedidos sin hijos o discapacidades calificadoras no calificara para Medicaid de Mississippi independientemente de cuan bajo caiga su ingreso. La Division de Medicaid de Mississippi administra el programa en medicaid.ms.gov. Para la mayoria de residentes de Mississippi que pierden un trabajo, el SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov es el unico camino hacia cobertura subsidiada.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA despues de perder un trabajo en Mississippi en 2026?
es.answer: COBRA raramente es la mejor opcion financiera despues de una perdida de trabajo en Mississippi. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, lo que significa que paga tanto la parte del empleador como la del empleado mas una tarifa administrativa del 2%. Para una persona en Mississippi, eso tipicamente alcanza $500 a $900 al mes en 2026; para una familia, $1,200 a $2,800 al mes. Los planes Silver del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima basados en ingresos en healthcare.gov tipicamente cuestan $10 a $300 al mes para solicitantes de Mississippi con ingresos proyectados moderados. COBRA tiene sentido principalmente cuando tiene tratamiento continuo con un especialista en Mississippi que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado.

es.question: Que es la brecha de cobertura en Mississippi y quien cae en ella?
es.answer: La brecha de cobertura de Mississippi afecta a adultos con ingresos anuales proyectados entre el 0% y 100% FPL que no tienen hijos calificadores o discapacidades. En 2026, el 100% FPL es $15,960 para una persona y $33,000 para una familia de cuatro. Estos adultos ganan muy poco para calificar para los subsidios del Mercado ACA (que comienzan al 100% FPL) pero no califican para Medicaid de Mississippi (que cubre a pocos adultos no discapacitados sin hijos). La brecha existe porque Mississippi eligio no expandir Medicaid. Los adultos en la brecha de cobertura de Mississippi pueden considerar COBRA si recientemente estaban empleados, o planes de corto plazo, pero no tienen opcion ACA subsidiada hasta que los ingresos superen el 100% FPL.

es.question: La compensacion por desempleo de Mississippi cuenta para la elegibilidad de subsidio ACA?
es.answer: Si. La compensacion por desempleo de Mississippi del Departamento de Seguridad del Empleo de Mississippi (MDES) cuenta como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para los calculos de subsidio ACA en healthcare.gov. Incluya su monto de beneficio semanal multiplicado por el numero de semanas que espera recibirlo en su ingreso anual proyectado de 2026. El beneficio semanal maximo de Mississippi es $235 por semana por hasta 26 semanas. Incluso con los maximos beneficios de desempleo de Mississippi, la mayoria de solicitantes individuales proyectan ingresos anuales muy por debajo del precipicio de subsidio del 400% FPL de $63,840.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de 60 dias despues de perder mi trabajo en Mississippi?
es.answer: Perder el SEP del Mercado de 60 dias despues de una perdida de trabajo en Mississippi significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan ACA subsidiado hasta el Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta 2027, que corre del 1 de noviembre de 2026 al 15 de enero de 2027 para cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. A diferencia de la mayoria de otros estados, el estado de no expansion de Mississippi significa que Medicaid no es una alternativa abierta para la mayoria de adultos durante la brecha. Si ocurre otro evento calificador de vida, ese evento reinicia un nuevo SEP de 60 dias. Los ninos de Mississippi aun pueden inscribirse en CHIP todo el ano en medicaid.ms.gov independientemente del estado SEP de un padre.

es.question: Que reglas estatales especificas aplican al seguro medico por perdida de trabajo en Mississippi en 2026?
es.answer: Mississippi no expandio Medicaid, dejando a la mayoria de adultos despedidos sin Medicaid como opcion. Mississippi usa healthcare.gov para la inscripcion en el Mercado, no un intercambio estatal separado. CHIP de Mississippi cubre ninos menores de 19 anos hasta el 200% FPL en medicaid.ms.gov. Los beneficios de desempleo de Mississippi estan limitados a $235 por semana por 26 semanas segun el Departamento de Seguridad del Empleo de Mississippi. Mississippi no tiene ley de cobertura de continuacion estatal comparable a Cal-COBRA para empleadores mas pequenos; el COBRA federal aplica a empleadores con 20 o mas empleados. La Division de Medicaid de Mississippi administra tanto Medicaid como CHIP; contactelos en medicaid.ms.gov o 1-800-421-2408.

es.question: Que pasa con la cobertura de mis hijos despues de perder mi trabajo en Mississippi?
es.answer: CHIP de Mississippi cubre ninos hasta los 18 anos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 200% FPL. La inscripcion en CHIP en Mississippi es todo el ano sin fecha limite, a diferencia del SEP del Mercado de 60 dias que aplica a la cobertura de adultos. Solicite CHIP de Mississippi en medicaid.ms.gov o a traves de healthcare.gov, que examina a todos los miembros del hogar simultaneamente. Aunque no califique para Medicaid de Mississippi como adulto despedido, la elegibilidad de CHIP de sus hijos se determina independientemente por su edad e ingresos del hogar. CHIP de Mississippi cubre beneficios completos incluyendo visitas de bienestar infantil, inmunizaciones, dental, vision y medicamentos recetados.
